title: Studying Blood Samples From Patients With Multiple Myeloma Who Were Treated With Thalidomide or Lenalidomide
brief_summary:
RATIONALE: Studying samples of blood from patients with cancer in the laboratory may help doctors learn more about changes that occur in DNA and identify biomarkers related to cancer. It may also help doctors predict how patients will respond to treatment.

PURPOSE: This research study is looking at blood samples from patients with multiple myeloma who were treated with thalidomide or lenalidomide.
raw_criteria:
DISEASE CHARACTERISTICS:

* Meets 1 of the following criteria:

  * Diagnosed with multiple myeloma and treated with thalidomide or lenalidomide on clinical trial ECOG-E4A03 or E-E1A00
  * Healthy volunteer

PATIENT CHARACTERISTICS:

* Not specified

PRIOR CONCURRENT THERAPY:

* See Disease Characteristics
study_population: Samples submitted for research from patients enrolled on E4A03 or E1A00
condition: Multiple Myeloma and Plasma Cell Neoplasm
